verdict.rationale: Highnote says its in-house compliance team runs KYC and KYB, and issuance is gated on an approved account-holder application. Applications can enter a manual-review state, and the Document Upload SDK collects identity documents at that point, so verification is clearly built into issuance with some review states. Missing for 10: documented KYC/KYB data requirements (required fields per consumer vs. business), a full enumeration of application review states, re-verification flows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
